2608.14079.title: The conditional superiority of fast silicon sampling
2608.14079.paper_summary: Silicon sampling can produce surprisingly good population estimates at times. Does doing it fast attenuate such fidelity? In this study, we extend and assess ongoing work in silicon sampling by comparing the algorithmic fidelity of "fast" and "slow" modes of silicon sampling among a nationally representative sample of Singaporean survey respondents. We find that silicon sampling with contemporary frontier models remains a method in early development to be used only with great caution. While silicon samples are able to produce moderately faithful estimates of population means, they continue to understate opinion variance and distort the latent contextual space behind human opinions. Conditional on such limitations, we find "fast" modes of silicon sampling to be relatively superior to traditional "slow" modes of silicon sampling. Fast silicon sampling is significantly more efficient in compute resources and run-time while being monotonically superior to slower modes of sampling in algorithmic fidelity.
2608.14079.paper_summary_zh: 矽採樣有時能產生令人驚訝的人口估計。快速進行是否會降低這種準確性？在本研究中，我們擴展並評估矽採樣的持續工作，通過比較新加坡全國代表性調查受訪者中“快速”和“慢速”模式的算法準確性。我們發現，使用當代前沿模型的矽採樣仍然是一種早期發展的方法，僅應謹慎使用。雖然矽樣本能夠產生適度忠實的人口均值估計，但它們仍然低估了意見的變異性，並扭曲了人類意見背後的潛在情境空間。在這些限制的條件下，我們發現“快速”模式的矽採樣相對於傳統的“慢速”模式更具優越性。快速矽採樣在計算資源和運行時間上顯著更有效率，同時在算法準確性上也單調優於較慢的採樣模式。
